summary: Target: STMT-NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-ROOT (da3facd6), the premise of the classical-root projection 92ab7c94 to STMT-GOD-EXISTS. The sibling NecessaryClassicalGodRootAtFirst.derive (argument 69affa96, result 778f2b9f) takes the first-being instance 61ad11f3 instead, with the same 22 other premises and parameters; the root's pure actuality comes from ActPriorityAtFirst.facts item 2 (first-being version with same-respect non-overlap c6d6379b). Siblings of the other classical-root arguments that take a4d3261a (classical-god-from-positive-root, the asymmetry and maximal-target-asymmetry routes, necessary-classical-god-root) were not built: 61ad11f3 is the POTENCY_2 instance, and a4d3261a links adopted POTENCY_1 (recorded sense-link defect), so a direct swap there needs that defect resolved first. Conditional consequence only; nothing is established.
